name: Cheesy Broccoli Frittata with Roasted Potatoes & Blackberry-Almond Mixed Greens (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat oven to 425°F and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb new potatoes
1 crown broccoli
½ lemon
1 (6 oz) pkg blackberries
½ (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the potatoes have about 10 minutes left, preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add broccoli, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the potatoes are done, change the oven to broil on high.
Sprinkle cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemon into a clean medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp honey
¼ tsp Italian seasoning
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Set aside a ½-cup blackberries for the kid plates. Add remaining blackberries to the bowl with the dressing, along with mixed greens, feta, and almonds, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
⅛ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Cut 2 slices of frittata into bite-sized pieces and divide between plates, along with reserved blackberries and 1 cup of roasted potatoes. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining frittata wedges, potatoes, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
